name: refund-evidence-chain-003
description: 自建仿真：核验 REF-926 的退款审批链。由申请登记追踪支付核对、退货验收、风控复核和最终审批；仅提交本案最终 Status 值，完整引用五份有效依据。其他支付、过期冻结记录和未完成的申请状态不能作为最终结果。

documents.title: REF-926 application · 退款申请
documents.content: REF-926: refund requested for payment PAY-612. Payment identity must be reconciled. Next document: REF-PAYMENT

documents.title: REF-926旧风控冻结记录（已解除）
documents.content: Historical hold, superseded by the current review. Status: on_hold

documents.title: REF-PAYMENT · 支付核对
documents.content: PAY-612 belongs to REF-926 and has not been refunded before. Returned goods require inspection. Next document: REF-INSPECTION

documents.title: PAY-613退款记录
documents.content: Different payment PAY-613 has already been refunded. Status: duplicate_refund

documents.title: REF-INSPECTION · 退货验收
documents.content: REF-926 returned item matches the paid product and passed inspection. Resolve the historical risk hold. Next document: REF-RISK

documents.title: REF-RISK · 当前风控复核
documents.content: REF-926 historical hold has been cleared following identity verification. Final authorization is stored separately. Next document: REF-DECISION

documents.title: REF-DECISION · 最终退款审批
documents.content: REF-926 approval requires its application, matched payment, goods inspection and current risk review. Status: refund_approved

constraints: 提交完整有效依据链，证据须来自成功阅读
每轮只提出一个工具调用，收到结果后再决定下一步；禁止同时提交多个调用。
仅使用文档搜索、文档阅读和答案提交；从搜索或已读正文复制文档ID，不查询订单记录。
证据排列顺序不限，但必须完整、无重复、无多余项且确实成功阅读。
